key_decisions: P0 foundation stabilization (Week 1-2) before P1 surface stabilization (Week 3-4)
Analyze-before-execute: each P0 item must have prior analyze
No Tool/Streaming/Workflow/Browser Runtime, no Multi-Agent/Scheduler/Event Bus
ADR Wave 2 only drafted, not frozen within window
BridgeError type + bridgeErrorToApiError mapping (not extending ApiErrorCode)
executeTask must re-throw errors (revision.value++ into finally block)
Bridge only writes TaskStore.failTask once (no duplicate failChatTask)
handleSendError unchanged — error transformation happens at bridge layer
phase_goal: Execute P0 stabilization items: Error Boundary formalization, WS/RT semantic drift closure, TaskResult type hardening, Execution observability implementation
success_criteria: Runtime errors produce typed BridgeError, mapped to ApiError at bridge boundary
TaskResult is a discriminated union supporting text/tool_calls/structured kinds
No semantic drift between WS and RT execution paths at user-facing level
Execution state visible via queryable API (not console.log)

in_scope: Error boundary formalization (BridgeError type + executeTask re-throw + executeChatTask refactor)
